summary: London is a card-driven city-building game where you develop your city hand by playing cards, then periodically 'run' the city to trigger all your building effects at once in an efficient engine-building sequence. The core tension is managing poverty and loans against building an efficient, high-scoring city.
praised: strong replayability from variable card draws
criticised: can feel solitaire-ish with limited direct interaction
poverty/loan bookkeeping can be fiddly for new players

interaction.kind: card drafting and indirect race for efficiency

scoring.why: final score combines built cards, city development, and penalties from poverty/loans
